test_MultiIndex_copy_method: test the MultiIndex.copy() method returns an equal copy with independent codes and names
test_MultiIndex_view_method: test the MultiIndex.view() method returns a shallow copy with equal levels and codes
test_MultiIndex_shallow_copy: test the MultiIndex._view() method returns a shallow copy with equal levels and codes
test_MultiIndex_deepcopy: test the MultiIndex.copy() method with deep=True and deep=False both return equal copies
test_MultiIndex_copy_kwargs: test the MultiIndex.copy() method honors kwargs like names when creating a copy
